newsitem.title: UK: Yorkshire-Tyne venture to gain assets.
newsitem.headline: Yorkshire-Tyne venture to gain assets.

text.p: British multimedia company Yorkshire International Thomson Multimedia (YITM) said it gained assets worth five million stg that would boost its presence in the multimedia segment catering to education.
YITM is a joint venture between Yorkshire-Tyne Tees Television (YIITV) and International Thomson Publishing (ITP).

In a statement, YTTTV said YTM would acquire Interactive Learning Productions (ILP), a division of ITP which specialises in the development of software for educational CD-Roms, for a consideration of 2.5 million stg.
YTTTV would contribute a series of feature length classical plays for YITM which would hold the rights to televisual material, the statement said.
YTTTV would provide advertising on its regional network and access to its archive along with production and facility funding.
